# A RANGE is a STRUCT in DuckDB, which functions that serialize or inspect values would see, so
# those functions are unsupported for RANGE until they are implemented.

SELECT APPROX_QUANTILES(r, 2) FROM UNNEST([RANGE(DATE '2020-01-01', NULL)]) r
=> error contains: The emulator does not support aggregate or analytic function APPROX_QUANTILES with RANGE

# RANGE_SESSIONIZE takes its column names and option only as non-NULL literals.
WITH ranges AS (SELECT RANGE<DATE> '[2024-01-01, 2024-02-01)' AS r) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RANGE_SESSIONIZE(TABLE ranges, NULL, [])
=> error contains: The emulator does not support RANGE_SESSIONIZE non-literal or NULL argument

WITH ranges AS (SELECT RANGE<DATE> '[2024-01-01, 2024-02-01)' AS r) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RANGE_SESSIONIZE(TABLE ranges, 'r', CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<STRING>))
=> error contains: The emulator does not support RANGE_SESSIONIZE non-literal or NULL argument

WITH ranges AS (SELECT RANGE<DATE> '[2024-01-01, 2024-02-01)' AS r) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RANGE_SESSIONIZE(TABLE ranges, 'r', [], NULL)
=> error contains: The emulator does not support RANGE_SESSIONIZE non-literal or NULL argument
